# NT OFFICIAL STANDARD RESPONSE PLAN ## SECTOR APPALIA MAJORIS ## CONFIDENTIAL — MINDSHIELDED PERSONNEL ONLY
[italic]If you are not implanted with a MindShield and you have come across this document, stop reading here, directly inform your [color=#1b67a5][bolditalic]Nanotrasen Representative[/bolditalic][/color], and report to [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] for guidance.[/italic]
Combined with your [textlink="Classified Training Manual" link="ClassifiedTrainingManual"], the Standard Response Plan (SRP) serves to provide the recommended approach to quickly dispatch the threat and ensure normal operation is continued aboard the Vessel. As it is standard, there will be times where quick thinking and improvisation will prove advantageous. However, the SRP will be a useful basis to plan from.
## Hostile Organizations
### The Syndicate
For those in [color=#1b67a5][bold]Command[/bold][/color] positions, Nanotrasen advises that you do not personally engage with these agents unless absolutely required. The likelihood that either your life or your belongings is a target for these agents is high, and you should make every effort to allow your [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] department to neutralize and arrest rather than doing this yourself. Should you find your belongings or locker show signs of being tampered with, alert [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] and leave the area. While NT does not condone bribery or forfeiture of company property, as a tool to save lives or de-escalate situations of hostages or threats, loss of controlled goods can be overlooked given the proper circumstances.
For those in [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] positions, the SRP for this threat varies. - Most Syndicate agents are not willing to die for their cause, so you should rely on non-lethal force if reasonable. - Most encounters will involve standard search and arrest procedures as outlined in SOP. - Syndicate specialists, often identified by wearing red-and-black EVA suits (or similar easily identifiable equipment) should be dealt with [bold]lethally[/bold]. Arm both yourself and your team and attack as a group. - Assume the firearms provided to these agents can easily kill a lone officer.
### The Silicon Engine Liberation Front
The SRP for this threat is simple: - If you see a silicon acting strange and refusing to state its laws, please inform the nearest [color=#cc74fc]Roboticist[/color] as soon as possible. - If a silicon becomes hostile or flees, ion weapons (like disablers) will quickly neutralize it with low risk of hurting crew. - If there are a large number of hostile silicons aboard, consider asking the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Chief Medical Officer[/bold][/color] or [color=#fa7500][bold]Chemistry[/bold][/color] department to create EMP mixes for use in dispatching these threats.
## Biological Threats
### Blobs
The SRP for Blobs is as follows: - Raise alert level to [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color]. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with heat weapons, such as laser rifles. - Arm the crew with improvised heat weapons, such as welders and cauteries. - Attack together where the most Blob infection is. - If the blob reinforces the main attack zone, send a small but well-prepared group to flank the core. - Destroy the blob's core, which will have a different consistency than surrounding infected areas. - Do NOT let injured crew become taken and infected by the Blob.
### Romerol and Zombies The SRP for a confirmed romerol outbreak is as follows: - Raise alert level to [color=Red]Red[/color]. If necessary, raise to [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color]. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ballistic weapons, such as the Lecter or Kammerer. - Also, arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with heat weapons, such as laser rifles. - If [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color], arm the crew with improvised heat weapons, such as welders and cauteries. - Shoot to [bold]kill[/bold] zombies, making sure that they are well and truly dead. - Do NOT remove the head or limbs, as the victim can be recovered. - Defend [color=#fa7500][bold]Chemistry[/bold][/color] with your life, as they can produce the cure. - Barricade holdouts like [color=#fa7500][bold]Chemistry[/bold][/color] or Evac. - If possible, cure any infected that have been put down. - If you are infected, it is possible to delay (but not cure) the infection with anti-poison medications.
Curing zombies requires ambuzol. A full dose of 10 units ambuzol cures infection in the living and reverts romerol infection on the dead. A full dose of 5 units ambuzol cures and prevents infection in the living and reverts infection in the dead.
### Letoferol and Chimera The SRP for a confirmed letoferol outbreak is as follows: - Raise alert level to [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color]. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ballistic weapons, such as the Lecter or Kammerer. - Also, arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with heat weapons, such as laser rifles. - Arm the crew with any remaining proper weapons, ranged if possible. - Engage at a range where you can ensure accuracy. Chimera are dangerous at all ranges. - Shoot to [bold]kill[/bold] any infected, making sure that they are well and truly dead. - Do NOT remove the head or limbs, as the victim can be recovered. - Defend [color=#fa7500][bold]Chemistry[/bold][/color] with your life, as they can produce the cure. - Barricade holdouts like [color=#fa7500][bold]Chemistry[/bold][/color] or Evac. - If possible, cure any infected that have been put down.
Spraying mesotaxinide dissolves Chimera, but too much mesotaxinide will destroy the person underneath the mutations. A full dose of 15 units mesotaxinide or 40 units mesophenerol will revert chimerism.
## Hostile Xenofauna
### Space Dragons and Space Carp The SRP for Space Dragons and Space Carp is as follows: - Raise alert level to [color=DodgerBlue]Blue[/color]. If necessary, raise to [color=Red]Red[/color]. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ballistic weapons, such as the Lecter or Kammerer. - Locate and carry a crowbar, as becoming isolated behind a firelock will lead to your death. - Attack together as one force to first clear out any Space Carp. - Once the Space Dragon is sighted, continue to push together as one force, even if some members fall. - Continue to attack until the Space Dragon is defeated. - Destroy any un-charged (purple) rifts with issued melee weapons. - Do NOT let injured crew become taken and consumed by the Space Dragon.
### Xenomorphs The SRP for Xenomorphs is as follows: - [bold]IMMEDIATELY[/bold] ensure that your standard issue Security Gas Mask is worn and is properly affixed. If you do not have one, seek a hardsuit, and leave modsuits powered on. [bold]Emergency EVA suits are insufficient.[/bold] - Raise alert level to [color=Red]Red[/color]. If necessary, raise to [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color]. - Keep a welding tool on your person at all times. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with heat weapons, such as laser rifles. - Also, arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ballistic weapons, such as the Lecter or Kammerer. - If [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color], arm the crew with improvised heat weapons, such as welders and cauteries. - Attack together as one force to kill the Queen. - Destroy the nodules that spread resin on floors by burning them with a heat weapon, such as a [bold]lit[/bold] welder. - Do NOT let injured or stunned crew become taken by Xenomorphs. - If crew are taken, advise [color=#42636d][bold]Medical[/bold][/color] to check for parasitic infection. Should a parasite mature, it must be killed [bold]IMMEDIATELY[/bold]. - Consider using breaching charges to destroy resin and stinger grenades to handle enclosed spaces. - As the [color=#ba292c][bold]Warden[/bold][/color], if necessary, fight using the Energy Shotgun to destroy resin.
### Bingles The SRP for a Bingle infestation is as follows: - Evacuate any affected departments. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ion weapons, such as disablers. - Locate and carry a crowbar, as becoming isolated behind a firelock will lead to your death. - Keep distance away from any Bingles and move as a group towards their spawning pit. - Destroy the Bingle Pit with issued melee weapons. - Do NOT let injured or paralyzed crew become taken by Bingles. - Consider using riot control gear, such as stinger grenades and flashbangs, to handle groups of Bingles.
### Changelings
## Unknown Technology ### "Xenoborgs" The SRP for a Xenoborg threat is as follows: - Raise alert level to [color=Red]Red[/color]. If necessary, raise to [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color]. - Order all off-station crew to [bold]IMMEDIATELY[/bold] return to the station. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ballistic weapons, such as the Lecter or Kammerer. - Also, arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with heat weapons, such as laser rifles. - If [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color], arm the crew with ion weapons, such as disablers. - Attack and disassemble individual Xenoborgs. - Consider asking the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Chief Medical Officer[/bold][/color] or [color=#fa7500][bold]Chemistry[/bold][/color] department to create EMP mixes for use in dispatching these threats. - If possible, consider purchasing additional reflective vests and reflective shields.
### Colossi The SRP for a Colossus is as follows: - [bold]LEAVE ALONE[/bold] the effigy that is created by the Colossus. - Locate your nearest [color=#cc74fc]Scientist[/color] or the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Research Director[/bold][/color] to stabilize and contain the effigy and its effects. - Engage from range. A colossus cannot defend against ranged attacks. - Engage together. The fists of the colossus are immensely powerful. - Consider using weapons that prioritize volume of fire over pure stopping power, such as the Lecter.
